people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Keilah
people.line: A town in the Shephelah of Judah, rescued by David

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: Then David inquired of Yahweh yet again. Yahweh answered him, and said, “Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into your hand.”
translations.bsb: Once again, David inquired of the LORD, and the LORD answered him: “Go at once to Keilah, for I will deliver the Philistines into your hand.”
translations.kjv: Then David enquired of the LORD yet again. And the LORD answered him and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into thine hand.
translations.asv: Then David inquired of Jehovah yet again. And Jehovah answered him, and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into thy hand.
